lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset contains approximately 2.6 million buildings with 74% estimated coverage based on AI-mapping validation. Data quality metrics indicate an average age of 1 year 9 months with 7% of features updated in the last 6 months.
